**What this changes, and why:**

**Tested on:** (make, model, model year and region, plus the head unit software version from the top of Tweaks and Settings → Support)

**How I tested it on the car:** (what you did, and what you saw)

**Calls into Hyundai or Kia code added or changed:** (Binder transaction codes, service methods, patched methods; "none" if none)

- [ ] This pull request has one bug fix or one feature, and nothing unrelated.
- [ ] I installed this build on a car and tested the change there.
- [ ] I attached a `tilepad-log-….zip` from **Save Log to USB**, taken after testing.
- [ ] I attached before and after screenshots from the car, or nothing on screen changed.

- [ ] `sh tools/build_apk.sh` passes.
- [ ] The README, the tweak's help text and the docs match the change.
